content: The Partnership for Family Health in Jordan and the Johns Hopkins Bloomberg School of Public Health/Center for Communication Programs were recognized for their innovative contributions to the field. Dr. Anna Altshuler led the development of this 2015 edition in collaboration with Dr. Erin Berry-Bibee, Dr. Kathryn Curtis, Dr. Monica Dragoman, Dr. Mary Lyn Gaffield, Dr. Tara Jatlaoui, and Ms. Halley Riley. The layout and design of the publication were managed by Ms. Cath Hamill. For those seeking additional copies or further information, detailed guidance on medical eligibility criteria, including recommendations for other contraceptive methods, is available in the Medical Eligibility Criteria for Contraceptive Use, 5th edition (2015). This resource can be accessed through the World Health Organization's reproductive health website.
